format.page_order_on_sheet: rtl_row_major(1p=シート右上、右→左、行送り)

pages.scene: 祭り前日の風魔の里。呪符を失くしたIbukiと、入り口で狐火を暴発させるUka

panels.prompt: Wide establishing shot, slightly high angle. Fuma ninja village decorated for festival: rows of red lanterns, wooden yagura tower under construction, villagers bustling. Warm afternoon light.

dialogue.speaker: ナレーション
dialogue.text: 風魔の里、祭りの前日。

panels.prompt: Medium shot, low angle. Immature young ninja {ibuki} dashing frantically through the crowd, arms flailing, panicked face. {yama} clinging on his shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: ないないない! 僕の呪符がないーっ!!

panels.prompt: Close-up on {yama} tilting with a deadpan expression. {ibuki}'s teary face in corner of frame, comic sweat marks.

dialogue.speaker: Yama
dialogue.text: ぴゅい(何回目?)

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 三回目だけど今回はご先祖さま直伝の本物なの!

pages.scene: 祭り前日の風魔の里。呪符を失くしたIbukiと、入り口で狐火を暴発させるUka

panels.prompt: Medium shot at village gate. Fox-summoning female ninja {uka} with protective amulet, standing stiffly, rehearsing a greeting, eyes swirling with nervousness. Nine-tailed fox flame aura flickering faintly behind her.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 『甲賀より祭りの祝いに…』ああ緊張してきた…

panels.prompt: Dynamic wide shot. Fox flames burst explosively from {uka}'s back, igniting a straw bundle beside the gate. {uka} flailing in panic, flames multiplying. Comic exaggerated fire.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: わーっ!? ごめんなさいごめんなさい!

panels.prompt: Medium two-shot. {yama} puffing up and spraying water on the fire. {ibuki} pointing at {uka} with full-power tsukkomi face, {uka} bowing apologetically, singed straw smoking behind.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 祝いに来ました。燃やしに来たんじゃないです

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 説得力ゼロだよ!!

pages.scene: 詫びとして屋台を手伝うことに。狐火点火成功、しかしダジャレ忍法が発覚

panels.prompt: Wide shot of takoyaki stall being set up. {ibuki} gesturing at the iron griddle, {uka} standing nervously beside it. Festival lanterns in background.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 詫びに屋台手伝ってね。たこ焼き屋! 火をおこして…あ

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: あ

panels.prompt: Close-up on {uka}'s face, eyes closed, deep breath, concentrating. A single beautiful small fox flame lit under the griddle below.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: すー、はー……よし、点火!

panels.prompt: Medium shot, {uka} smug with hand on chest, proud smile. {ibuki} impressed. Bright cheerful mood lines.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: できるじゃん!

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: この調子で、たこがトンでもなく売れちゃう…あっ

pages.scene: 詫びとして屋台を手伝うことに。狐火点火成功、しかしダジャレ忍法が発覚

panels.prompt: Gag wide shot, low angle looking up. An octopus flying into the sky flapping its legs like wings. {uka} and {ibuki} below, jaws dropped, white eyes. {yama} tilting confused.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: な、なにいまの!?

panels.prompt: Medium two-shot. {uka} confessing sheepishly with finger poking, {ibuki} full tsukkomi with veins popping.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: ダジャレを言うと本当に起きちゃう体質で…

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: そんな迷惑な体質ある!?

panels.prompt: Gag panel. {ibuki} fallen head-first into the ground, legs sticking up (zukkoke). Beside stall, a small summoned fox cub with troubled face appears in a puff of smoke. {uka} covering mouth.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: お客さんが狐(こ)まらないように…

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 早速言ってるー!!

pages.scene: Ibuki呪符探しで里中を駆け回る。戻ると屋台は大繁盛、呪符はYamaのおでこに

panels.prompt: Wide comic montage-style shot. {ibuki} searching frantically: under the yagura tower, behind a taiko drum, inside a mochi mortar while an old man scolds him. Speed lines, sweat drops.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 呪符~! 僕の呪符~!

panels.prompt: Wide shot from {ibuki}'s POV. Huge queue at the takoyaki stall. Fox cubs wearing headbands flipping takoyaki, village children crowding and cheering.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: え!? なんで大行列!?

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 子狐たちが看板娘で大繁盛です!

panels.prompt: Medium shot. {uka} holding out an old talisman paper to {ibuki}, gentle smile. {ibuki}'s eyes sparkling huge with tears of joy.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: これ、お客さんが落し物だって

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 僕の『大切な呪符』ーー!!

pages.scene: Ibuki呪符探しで里中を駆け回る。戻ると屋台は大繁盛、呪符はYamaのおでこに

panels.prompt: Gag close-up. {yama} with the talisman peeled off its forehead, winking cutely with a star mark. {ibuki} grabbing his own head in disbelief.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: Yamaちゃんのおでこに貼りついてました

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 一番近くにいたやつ!! 僕の三日間返して!?

panels.prompt: Sudden serious wide shot. Huge explosion and black smoke rising at the edge of the village. Everyone frozen mid-zukkoke, turning toward the blast. Tone shift to dark.
Medium shot. A Fuma ninja shouting and pointing, villagers panicking. {ibuki} and {uka}'s faces turning serious, wind blowing.

dialogue.speaker: 風魔忍
dialogue.text: 敵襲! 抜け忍だ! 供物を狙ってるぞ!!

pages.scene: 供物殿前。仲間を庇い呪符で防戦一方のIbuki、駆けつけたUkaは緊張で狐火が暴発

panels.prompt: Wide dramatic shot in front of the offering hall. Fallen Fuma ninjas on the ground. Small {ibuki} standing with arms spread wide, protecting them. Shadowy rogue ninjas approaching. Dusk lighting.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: ここから先は、通さない…!

dialogue.speaker: 抜け忍
dialogue.text: がきんちょに何ができる

panels.prompt: Dynamic action shot. Shuriken raining down. Glowing barrier of talisman papers deflecting them, sparks flying. {ibuki} gritting teeth, talismans burning away one by one.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 泰山府君の儀・結界符ッ!

panels.prompt: Medium shot from behind {uka} arriving, seeing {ibuki}'s small battered back holding the crumbling barrier. Her eyes wide.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 来ちゃだめ! …っていうか来て! 加勢して!

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: どっち!?

pages.scene: 供物殿前。仲間を庇い呪符で防戦一方のIbuki、駆けつけたUkaは緊張で狐火が暴発

panels.prompt: Close-up on {uka}'s trembling hands trying to form a seal. Inner monologue box. Her face pale with fear, sweat.

dialogue.speaker: Ukaモノローグ
dialogue.text: (失敗したら…仲間ごと燃やしたら…)

panels.prompt: Gag-tinged panel amid tension. Fox flames misfire sideways, burning only the stall lanterns in the distance. {ibuki} tsukkomi face while still defending.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: うわ関係ないとこ燃えた!?

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: ご、ごめん、緊張すると…!

panels.prompt: Dramatic low-angle close-up. The rogue leader grinning wickedly with a giant iron fan. Behind him, the last barrier talisman shattering, {ibuki} falling to his knees.

dialogue.speaker: 頭目
dialogue.text: 風魔の結界も限界のようだなァ

pages.scene: 絶体絶命でUkaが初めて本音を叫び、完全制御の九尾狐火が覚醒する

panels.prompt: Emotional close-up on {uka} shouting with tears at the corners of her eyes, fists clenched. Background abstract, emotional flash lines.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 私ね! 本当はずっと怖かったの! Otoに負けてばっかりで…!

panels.prompt: Medium shot. {uka} gripping her amulet, gaze now steady and fierce, staring straight at the leader. Wind lifting her hair.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 友達がやられそうなの! もう震えてる場合じゃないのよ!!

panels.prompt: Full dramatic wide shot. Nine perfect fox flames blooming behind {uka}'s back like a fan, illuminating the night. Awe on {ibuki}'s face.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 忍法・九尾狐火の陣!!

pages.scene: 絶体絶命でUkaが初めて本音を叫び、完全制御の九尾狐火が覚醒する

panels.prompt: Dynamic action wide shot. Nine flame foxes charging at rogue ninjas, enemies tumbling comically with scorched bottoms.

dialogue.speaker: 抜け忍たち
dialogue.text: ぎゃあ! あちちち!

panels.prompt: Tense medium shot. The leader deflecting flames with his giant iron fan, lunging toward kneeling {ibuki}.

dialogue.speaker: 頭目
dialogue.text: ならば小僧から先だ!

panels.prompt: Quiet dramatic close-up. {ibuki}'s face calm and resolute, no more tears. {yama} beside him, the ancestral talisman glowing faintly gold in his hand.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: …Yama。『大切な呪符』が戻ってきたんだ。できるよね

dialogue.speaker: Yama
dialogue.text: ぴゅい

pages.scene: Yamaの変身が微妙で緊張と緩和、しかし一瞬の反撃で頭目撃破

panels.prompt: Build-up panel. {yama} glowing, about to transform, dramatic light burst. Expectation lines everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: ナレーション
dialogue.text: Yamaが巨大な閻魔の姿に――

panels.prompt: Gag anticlimax close-up. {yama} unchanged, only with tiny dignified eyebrows added. {ibuki}'s face frozen mid-shock.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: そこは変身するとこでしょ!?

panels.prompt: Dynamic action shot. {ibuki} throwing the golden glowing ancestral talisman, a single decisive counterattack. Speed lines, sharp determined eyes.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: まあいいや! 泰山府君の儀・一点返しッ!!

pages.scene: Yamaの変身が微妙で緊張と緩和、しかし一瞬の反撃で頭目撃破

panels.prompt: Impact panel. Talisman sticking to the leader's iron fan, massive golden explosion engulfing him.
Gag wide shot of night sky. The leader flying off as a twinkling star in the distance. Classic kirakira star effect.

dialogue.speaker: 頭目
dialogue.text: おのれぇぇ…

panels.prompt: Relieved medium two-shot. {uka} and {ibuki} looking at each other, panting, then smiling. {yama} bouncing triumphantly between them.

dialogue.speaker: UkaとIbuki
dialogue.text: ……勝った?

dialogue.speaker: Yama
dialogue.text: ぴゅい!(勝った!)

pages.scene: 祭り当日。Ukaは子供たちに狐火の稽古、Ibukiはバレバレの九尾変装

panels.prompt: Bright festive wide shot, daytime. Festival in full swing. {uka} surrounded by village children, teaching fox flame practice, children's eyes sparkling.

dialogue.speaker: 子供たち
dialogue.text: Ukaねえちゃん! 狐火みせて!

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: コツはね、心をこう(ここ)ろがすの

panels.prompt: Gag panel. A fox flame rolling on the ground like a ball, children chasing it delightedly. {uka} covering mouth in oops-face.

dialogue.speaker: 子供たち
dialogue.text: わー! 転がったー!

panels.prompt: Medium shot at stall. {ibuki} flipping takoyaki while doing a tsukkomi over his shoulder — but wearing a fox mask on the side of his head and nine fluffy handmade tails at his waist, one tail dangling half-off.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: またダジャレ発動してるよ!?

pages.scene: 祭り当日。Ukaは子供たちに狐火の稽古、Ibukiはバレバレの九尾変装

panels.prompt: Gag close-up. {ibuki} in his terrible fox disguise, chest puffed with absolute confidence, sparkle effects around him. {yama} covering its face in embarrassment.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 私は甲賀の九尾の忍『Ubuki』。Ibukiではありません

panels.prompt: Medium two-shot, role reversal. {uka} doing the full-power tsukkomi with pointing finger and popping veins, {ibuki} smugly unbothered.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 名前ほぼそのままだし誰が見てもIbukiでしょ!

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: バレていません

panels.prompt: Close-up on {uka} mid-rant, grabbing the fake tails, one tail popping off in her hand. Her face freezing as she realizes she said a forbidden word.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 一本取れて八尾なの! 『きゅうび』って言ったからには…あっ

pages.scene: 最終見開き。ダジャレ忍法大暴発、『シーン…』が床に落ちてYamaが食べる大オチ

panels.prompt: Gag disaster wide shot. {uka}'s real nine tails all drooping flat down (kyuubi on kyuujitsu). On the griddle, all takoyaki turned into bowls of clear soup. Both stunned with white eyes.

dialogue.speaker: 二人
dialogue.text: きゅうびが休日に!? たこ焼きがお吸い…!?

panels.prompt: Surreal gag panel. In dead silence, the literal characters「シーン…」falling off and clattering onto the floor as physical objects. Everyone staring at them.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: もう何が何だか!!

panels.prompt: Biggest gag close-up. {yama} picking up the fallen「シーン…」letters and eating them with a happy face. {uka}, {ibuki} and children all screaming in shock behind.

dialogue.speaker: 全員
dialogue.text: 食べたーーーっ!?

pages.scene: 最終見開き。ダジャレ忍法大暴発、『シーン…』が床に落ちてYamaが食べる大オチ

panels.prompt: Grand zukkoke wide shot. Everyone flipped over on the ground, stall sign tilting, fox cubs cheerfully shouting irrelevantly, festival music notes floating in the air.

dialogue.speaker: 子狐
dialogue.text: へい、おあいそ!

panels.prompt: Warm medium two-shot. {uka} and {ibuki} lying flipped over, looking at each other and bursting into laughter. Soft festival lantern light.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: …ねえUka。祭り、まだ始まったばっかりだよ

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: うん。次はもっと客を、キツネ(来つね)…

panels.prompt: Final gag wide shot, pull-back view of the whole village. A hundred fox cubs pouring out in puffs of smoke everywhere, {ibuki} screaming, {uka} laughing, {yama} bouncing. Festival lanterns glowing. The end.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: もう言うなあああああ!!!
